parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen part of a display, primarily made of glass with a thin plastic or metal frame. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays images, videos, and text. It serves as the primary output interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed and does not move independently, though it may tilt slightly depending on the base design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum for stability and support. It connects the screen to the surface it stands on.
parts.Functional_description: The base supports the screen, maintaining balance and allowing for tilt or rotation adjustments in some designs.
parts.Movement_description: The base may allow limited rotational or tilt movement of the screen, but it remains stationary on the surface.
